purpose: Make 2007/2002 immediately discoverable by the national, legal and rolling-origin pipeline after one source-specific normalization step.

required.votes: dictionary of raw list/party labels to absolute vote counts
required.native_local_row_count: must preserve the source election's real districting; do not force 92 rows

validation: Native local row count matches the source election rather than the 2011+ geometry.
Every local vote vector is non-negative and has positive total.
District magnitude is present and local seat totals match the applicable legal regime.
Original raw source is archived and hashed.
No result from a later election may be used to repair an earlier pre-election snapshot or boundary bridge.

automatic_effect.national_layer: immediately active for every newly discovered canonical year because aggregation is geometry-independent
automatic_effect.legal_allocator_replay: immediately active if full list-level votes and applicable legal inputs are present
automatic_effect.territorial_layer: activates only through an admissible common-geometry bridge when native districting differs
automatic_effect.rolling_origin: new year is automatically inserted in chronological folds; unavailable territorial components remain explicitly blocked rather than guessed

note: If the source arrives as Excel/PDF/CSV, only the source-specific normalization adapter remains. Boundary harmonization is a separate controlled pipeline stage, not part of source ingestion.
